statement: Cejel's first plain first page (#635) printed false sentences on 656 reviewed reports because its word guard chose replacement over rewording: any engine text holding a banned word was swapped for one generic sentence, so areas that failed to read became "found nothing here it could measure" and every insufficient-source reason became "found no source code here that it can rate". Its test passed because it fed a reason the engine never emits. The v2 fix (goal_cejel_four_question_summary_v2_2026-11-03) keys each sentence on the producer's kind and rewords through a fixed table. Rules: when a renderer restates engine output in other words, list every producer of that field in a test and feed the test text the engine actually emitted; reword through a table instead of replacing; and give a guard that blocks a word a fallback that says less, never one that says something different.
